question_fa: بر اساس محاسبات نظری، نیم‌پهنای خطوط CO2 در پهن‌شدگی با بخار آب در مقایسه با پهن‌شدگی با هوا تا چند برابر می‌تواند برسد؟
translation: Based on theoretical calculations, how many times can the half-width of CO2 spectral lines due to broadening by water vapor exceed the broadening by air?
original_en: According to theoretical calculations, how large can water-vapor-broadened half-widths of CO2 lines become compared to air-broadened ones?

question_fa: برای به دست آوردن ضرایب پهن‌شدگی CH4 با بخار آب، چه ضریب مقیاسی روی پارامترهای پهن‌شدگی با هوا اعمال شد؟
translation: For obtaining the broadening coefficients of CH4 with water vapor, what scaling factor was applied to the broadening parameters with air?
original_en: What scaling factor was applied to the air-broadening parameters of CH4 to obtain its water-vapor broadening coefficients?

question_fa: برای نمای دمایی پهن‌شدگی CH4 با بخار آب از چه ضریب مقیاسی استفاده شد؟
translation: What scaling factor was used for the temperature exponent of CH4 linewidth with water vapor?
original_en: What scaling factor was used for the temperature-dependence exponents of water-vapor broadening of CH4?

question_fa: Delahaye و همکاران نیم‌پهنای لورنتس خطوط CO2 پهن‌شده با بخار آب را در چه دماهایی تعیین کردند؟
translation: What temperature ranges did Delahaye and co-workers determine for the Lorentz half-widths of CO2 spectral lines broadened by water vapor?
original_en: At which temperatures did Delahaye et al. determine Lorentz half widths of CO2 transitions broadened by water vapor?

question_fa: Sung و همکاران نیم‌پهنای پهن‌شدگی با بخار آب را برای چند خط 12CO2 گزارش کردند؟
translation: What were the half-widths of the water vapor broadening for several 12CO2 spectral lines reported by Sung and co-workers?
original_en: How many 12CO2 lines with water-vapor broadening half widths were reported by Sung et al.?

question_fa: با طیف‌سنجی cavity ring-down قفل‌شده به شانه‌ی فرکانسی در 2 میکرون، کدام خط و باند CO2 مطالعه شد؟
translation: Which spectral line and band of CO2 were studied using cavity ring-down spectroscopy with a frequency-modulated probe at 2 microns?
original_en: Which CO2 line and band were studied with comb-locked cavity ring-down spectroscopy at 2 µm?

question_fa: عدد موج خط R(50) باند 20012-00001 مولکول CO2 که با طیف‌سنجی cavity ring-down اندازه‌گیری شد چقدر است؟
translation: What is the wavenumber of the R(50) line in the 20012–00001 band of CO2 molecules measured by cavity ring-down spectroscopy?
original_en: What is the wavenumber of the R(50) line of the CO2 20012-00001 band measured with comb-locked cavity ring-down spectroscopy?

question_fa: طیف‌های cavity ring-down خط R(50) مولکول CO2 در چه بازه‌ی فشاری ثبت شدند؟
translation: What pressure range was used to record the cavity ring-down spectra of the R(50) line of the CO2 molecular transition?
original_en: Over what pressure range were the CO2 R(50) cavity ring-down spectra recorded?

question_fa: افت‌وخیز 1-σ فرکانس مرکز خط برای طیف‌سنج cavity ring-down قفل‌شده به شانه چقدر بود؟
translation: How much was the 1-σ frequency shift of the central line frequency for a cavity ring-down spectroscopy sensor with a fixed cavity?
original_en: What 1-σ fluctuation of the line-center frequency was found for the comb-locked cavity ring-down spectrometer?

question_fa: زمان ring-down کاواک خالی برای تشدیدگر نوری با فینس بالا در اندازه‌گیری CO2 در 2 میکرون چقدر است؟
translation: What is the ring-down time of a high-finesse optical resonator for measuring CO2 at 2 microns?
original_en: What is the empty-cavity ring-down time of the high-finesse optical resonator used for CO2 at 2 µm?

question_fa: HITRAN برای به دست آوردن ضرایب پهن‌شدگی خطوط CO2 با H2 از ضرایب پهن‌شدگی با هوا از چه ضریب مقیاسی استفاده می‌کند؟
translation: What scaling factor does HITRAN use to obtain the CO2 line broadening coefficients with H2 from the broadening coefficients with air?
original_en: What scaling factor does HITRAN use to obtain H2-broadening coefficients of CO2 lines from air-broadening coefficients?

question_fa: ضرایب پهن‌شدگی و جابه‌جایی فشاری با H2 برای چند خط CO2 در ناحیه‌ی 4.3 میکرون اندازه‌گیری شد؟
translation: What are the broadening coefficients and pressure shifts with H2 for several CO2 spectral lines in the 4.3 micron region?
original_en: For how many CO2 lines were H2 pressure-broadening and shift coefficients measured in the 4.3 µm region?

question_fa: Padmanabhan و همکاران چه بازه‌ای از ضرایب پهن‌شدگی با H2 را برای خطوط CO2 در باند 30012←00001 اندازه گرفتند؟
translation: What range of broadening coefficients did Padmanabhan and colleagues measure for H2 with respect to CO2 lines in the 30012←00001 band?
original_en: What range of H2 broadening coefficients did Padmanabhan et al. measure for CO2 lines in the 30012←00001 band?

question_fa: برای طیف‌های تبدیل فوریه‌ی CO2 رقیق‌شده در H2 از چه تفکیک طیفی استفاده شد؟
translation: What spectral resolution was used for the Fourier transform spectra of diluted CO2 in H2?
original_en: What spectral resolution was used for the Fourier transform spectra of CO2 diluted in H2?

question_fa: ضریب کالیبراسیون مقیاس عدد موج طیف‌های تبدیل فوریه‌ی CO2-H2 چقدر به دست آمد؟
translation: What is the calibration coefficient of the wavenumber scale for the Fourier transform spectra of CO2-H2?
original_en: What calibration factor was obtained for the wavenumber scale of the CO2-H2 Fourier transform spectra?

question_fa: ضریب پهن‌شدگی خودی خط NH3 در 1.2 میکرون که در دمای 150 کلوین اندازه‌گیری شده چقدر است؟
translation: What is the self-broadening coefficient of the NH3 spectral line at 1.2 microns measured at 150 Kelvins?
original_en: What is the self-broadening coefficient of the NH3 line at 1.2 µm measured at 150 K?
